howItWorks.subtitle: A simple, transparent flow from discovery to trip completion.
clientFlowSteps: Client opens the CityRide mobile app

howItWorks.contactEventBody: Calling a rider creates a Contact Event. It records the client's attempt to reach a rider — it does not automatically represent a completed trip.
howItWorks.note: This distinction is core to how CityRide works: a Contact Event is a record of contact intent, while a Trip Request follows its own lifecycle from request to completion.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers based on how the CityRide system actually works.

clientItems.a: CityRide is a mobile platform that helps clients discover nearby riders and connect with them directly.

clientItems.q: How do I find nearby riders?
clientItems.a: Open the CityRide app and allow location access. Nearby available riders will be shown automatically.

clientItems.q: What happens when I tap Call?
clientItems.a: Tapping Call creates a Contact Event, which records your attempt to reach that rider.

clientItems.q: Is a Contact Event the same as a trip?
clientItems.a: No. A Contact Event only records contact intent. A trip follows the separate Trip Request lifecycle.

clientItems.q: What happens after a Trip Request is created?
clientItems.a: The Trip Request moves through Requested, Accepted or Rejected, In Progress, and finally Completed or Cancelled.

clientItems.q: What happens if no nearby rider is available?
clientItems.a: The app will let you know that no riders were found nearby so you can try again shortly.

riderItems.q: How do I become a CityRide rider?
riderItems.a: Create a rider account in the app and complete the onboarding process.

riderItems.q: What information is required during onboarding?
riderItems.a: You will need to provide identity documentation, license documentation, and vehicle information.
Administrators review your submitted documents in the Admin Panel and update your verification status.

riderItems.q: How do I go online or offline?
riderItems.a: Use the availability toggle in the app to set yourself online or offline at any time.
While you are online, the app shares your current location so nearby clients can discover you.
